verdict.rationale: SerpApi ships official SDKs (e.g. google-search-results-python, with a newer serpapi-python successor) with GitHub-documented usage examples, plus markdown-formatted output explicitly optimized for LLMs/AI agents and an official MCP server for agentic integration. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer corroboration of SDK reliability/coverage across all languages, and no unified official SDK docs page consolidating all supported languages beyond Python.
